i made $2.4m last year selling ai ebooks i never even wrote

here's how in 10 steps:

1. open an x account (2 mins)
2. pick a niche that pays — money, fitness, dating
3. tell chatgpt to write a 40-page ebook on it (5 mins)
4. make a cover in canva (3 mins)
5. upload to gumroad, price it $27
6. write a hook post: "i built a 40pg [niche] guide" (1 min)
7. post it, reply to every comment for 30 mins
8. auto-dm the link to anyone who comments a keyword
9. repeat daily across 3 accounts
10. 200 sales/mo at $27 = $5,400/mo per account

no face. no ads. no experience.

comment "EBOOK" and i'll dm you my exact prompt + cover template, free

must be following me + retweet this or the bot skips you

my friend gets 4 million views a month and makes almost nothing.

i offered to show him EXACTLY how to turn that into six figures. for free. no catch.

he said no.

why? because he's scared. he thinks it "won't work for him." he'd rather protect the story in his head than test it once.

let me be blunt: fear doesn't lower your odds. fear GUARANTEES you fail. every single time. you don't lose because the plan is bad. you lose because you never run it.

i have accounts with 800 followers that out-earn his 4 million views. read that again. reach is not money. reach is just NOISE until you build the machine underneath it.

so here's your final chance, brother. you're standing on a goldmine and choosing to starve on top of it. millions of hands are raised and you're too afraid to hand them a $20 pdf.

do something. or watch it rot.

digital products are the single best business on earth (i did $2.4m last year at 21).

nothing else even comes close.

100% profit margins.
delivered the second they pay.
no face needed.
ai writes the actual product for you.
the funnel runs on full autopilot while you sleep.

my students are pulling anywhere from $3k to $40k a month doing this exact thing, some inside their first 30 days.

so do you want me to show you the whole system, step by step?

comment "SYSTEM" and i'll send you:
– my free 6-module course
– the PDF blueprint i used to hit $2.4m
– my full resource board (tools, prompts, templates)

all of it free.

must be following me + retweet this so it can actually reach you.
